budgetInterpretation: Owned-worker7200s execution timeout includes worker staging/hashes/tools; cleanup waits after expiry and parent preflight/final collection may extend elapsed wall time. Per-command maxima do not add another allowance.

redirectPolicy: Local explicit no-proxy opener rejects301/302/303/307/308 before any followup; closes response even without usable Location; final URL/SHA/size/private guards remain
